title: Authorization and Representative Documentation Requirements — Medical Records Requests
content:
Each Medical Records Requests type states whether a signed HIPAA release authorization from the patient or representative is required, the calendar days within which a requested authorization must be returned signed, and the calendar months a signed authorization stays valid when it states no earlier expiration.

## Authorization figures

| Request type | Signed release authorization required | Return window (calendar days after it is requested) | Validity when no earlier expiration is stated (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | No | 0 | 0 |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | No | 0 | 0 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | No | 0 | 0 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | No | 0 | 0 |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | Yes | 30 | 12 |
| Certified Legal Records Package | Yes | 30 | 12 |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | No | 0 | 0 |

Only the two types that require a signed authorization carry a return window and a validity period.

## Representatives, court process and changes of recipient

| Request type | Personal representative supplies guardianship, power-of-attorney or estate documentation | Court subpoena or order required when no patient authorization is given | Changing the recipient needs a new signed authorization |
|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | No | No | No |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | Yes | No | No |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | Yes | No | No |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | No | No | Yes |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | Yes | No | Yes |
| Certified Legal Records Package | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | Yes | No | No |

## Notes on the tables

- The Certified Legal Records Package is the only type that requires a court subpoena or order when no patient authorization is given.
- Three types require a new signed authorization for a change of recipient: the Provider-to-Provider Transfer, the Third-Party Authorized Release and the Certified Legal Records Package.
- Representative documentation is required on every type except the Portal Self-Service Download and the Provider-to-Provider Transfer.
